description: This file defines the 'nusoap_parser' class, which parses SOAP XML messages into PHP data structures, and handles various aspects of SOAP message processing including XML parsing, type decoding, and structure building.

classes.name: nusoap_parser
classes.description: A class for parsing SOAP XML messages into PHP structures, handling SOAP envelope, header, body, and data types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and parses the SOAP XML message.

methods.name: start_element
methods.description: Handler for the start of an XML element during parsing.

methods.name: end_element
methods.description: Handler for the end of an XML element during parsing, building PHP result structures.

methods.name: character_data
methods.description: Handler for character data inside XML elements.

methods.name: get_response
methods.description: Returns the parsed SOAP response (deprecated alias for get_soapbody).

methods.name: get_soapbody
methods.description: Returns the parsed SOAP Body data.

methods.name: get_soapheader
methods.description: Returns the parsed SOAP Header data.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the raw SOAP headers XML.

methods.name: decodeSimple
methods.description: Decodes an XML simple type value into a PHP variable based on its type.

methods.name: buildVal
methods.description: Constructs PHP data structures from parsed XML nodes, handling arrays, structs, and simple types.
